root_cause: Portal V2 had per-page questions, source signals and task workflows, but no single consent-driven voice control with customer-configured KPI thresholds, provenance-aware explanations and an owned follow-up action. Without a canonical user-scoped rule, a UI might show invented anomalies or fail to persist changes.
prevention_rule: All customer alerts must depend on authenticated, non-demo tenant-sourced values or an explicit missing-data rule. Never classify absent values as threshold breaches. Author rules and assigned actions only through original Portal Domain State / BusinessInput with independent server readback; never create a second store or scheduler.
regression_contract: Voice intent creates a reviewed command; tenant demo/anonymous inputs fail closed; threshold anomalies require numeric source; tasks require explicit owner, due date and triggered rule; production only after exact PR-head CI and Netlify evidence.

evidence.source: Portal V2 existing app, router, state client, Domain State, 2026-11-20
